cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 applies '{default: 5, ...} to the int member of a nested unpacked structure but leaves its bit [3:0] member 0 ("5 0000 1" in the standalone source; a top-level '{default: 5} sets both). IEEE 1800-2023 10.9.2 applies the default recursively to each member of an unmatched substructure and evaluates it in the context of an assignment to a simple bit vector member, giving 4'b0101.

cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 evaluates the index of a nonblocking assignment to a 129-bit member of an unpacked-structure array when applying the NBA update. cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 evaluates a 32-bit shift before converting it to the 64-bit member type, yielding 0 for 32'd1 << 40, and zero-extends -32'sd1 to 0x00000000ffffffff. IEEE 1800-2023 7.2.2 and 11.8.2 require assignment-context sizing; the expected values are 0x10000000000 and 0xffffffffffffffff.
